Reviewer (grammar): '1 days' is ungrammatical; both occurrences should read '1 day'/'1 more day'. Also '2000年是国年' has a typo in the source likely meaning 闰年, but translation correctly renders leap year. Suggested translation: "The year of 365 days we usually talk about is only approximate; the exact value is 365 days 5 hours 48 minutes 46 seconds. For convenience, people take a year as 365 days, called a common year, so every four years the time is nearly 1 day short of the exact value. To make up this difference, 1 more day is added to month 2 of that year, and the year has 366 days; such a year is called a leap year. It is also laid down that for years ending in two 0s, only those divisible by 400 are leap years: for example, 2000 is a leap year, but 1700 is not."

details.suggested_fix: The year of 365 days we usually talk about is only approximate; the exact value is 365 days 5 hours 48 minutes 46 seconds. To make up this difference, 1 more day is added to month 2 of that year, and the year has 366 days; such a year is called a leap year.
